qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.lowering: RSP receives RBP, then the existing transactional qword stack-pop path loads the caller RBP and advances RSP.
admission.boundedRule: Only the qword form in long mode lowers to native IR. Operand-size-overridden 16-bit LEAVE remains on the architectural interpreter path.
admission.restartability: The native block mutates only its private execution context until the stack read succeeds. A failed read returns the original RSP, RBP, RIP, flags, and memory.

verification.focusedGate: Three tier-one stack and LEAVE tests pass.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,460 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: A nontrivial old RSP, frame RBP, loaded caller RBP, unchanged memory, flags, and final RIP match the interpreter.
verification.faultCoverage: An unmapped frame address causes the tier-one callback exit to preserve the complete block-entry state and memory.
verification.negativeCoverage: The 16-bit operand-size-overridden long-mode form declines tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. The previously measured LEAVE site's absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

nextVisibleSites.limitation: The retained diagnostics do not capture live instruction bytes or user-image load bases, so this site is not identified by static offset inference.
The one-byte live block differs from the six-byte static image at this alternatives-patched site; live bytes remain required before lowering.

interpretation: The general long-mode LEAVE lowering executes successfully in the authenticated workload and removes the previously measured 103,976-hit kernel LEAVE site from the retained negative-cache sample. A05.2 remains open because 119,616 of 221,822 tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
